alltools.compare.select-files-to-compare.note: printcraft commands.rs:226 opens the Compare Files dialog to pick the older version among the open documents. This window has no other open documents to pick from, so the older version is a file: the system Open dialog.

compare.show.label: Show
compare.show.note: Show: Text lists and shades the text differences. The Visual choice (page against page, rendering both files) is not translated, so it is not offered.

compare.side-by-side.note: Hidden: upstream puts the old file's tab beside the new file's. The older version is read from a file here and is not open in a tab, so the new file shows alone.

compare.new-only.note: Hidden with Side by side: the new file alone is how the comparison shows here.

compare.report.note: printcraft opens the report as a new tab; here it is saved as a PDF (the system Save dialog).

compare.filter.note: Hidden: Acrobat's Filter (text, images, annotations, formatting, background) is not in printcraft, which compares text only.
